title: CoT Monitoring in a Multi-Agent Setting: Does Monitor Accuracy Degrade with Agent Handoffs?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: multi-agent systems are rapidly proliferating and monitoring is an identified open problem. A negative result (monitoring degrades) would be a critical finding for the field. Direct safety relevance.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Constructing a two-agent pipeline with orchestrator+subagent, injecting malicious behavior into one, and running monitoring in multiple configurations is complex. Multi-agent orchestration is challenging for beginners. Requires significant infrastructure setup.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Building a multi-agent pipeline is itself a project. Then injecting malicious behavior, running monitoring in two conditions (joint vs. single-agent trace), and analyzing results. Too many components for 30 hours.
